summary: Marvell Technology filed a routine Form 8-K on September 25, 2026 announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share, declared by its board. The dividend is payable October 29, 2026 to holders of record as of October 9, 2026, covering common stock and preferred stock on an as-converted-to-common basis. No advisor is named and no strategic transaction is disclosed; the filing includes the related press release as Exhibit 99.1. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration with no special-situation mechanics, so no risk-arbitrage angle applies.
